name: smoke-window
description: cart plays his recording into the Apartments, smokes the window over B at 15 s (S1: the smoke flies on the CS2 grenade engine, aimed at the floor by the window, and pops there at 17.8 s; X1d: on the 2020 mesh a throw from the Apartments door at 14 s hits the corridor wall at once, so he throws from further in, 20 u further south) and walks to his recorded spot (within the spot tolerance from 18 s, over the recorded hit at 18.5 s), hidden from Lokier by the smoke: no encounter starts. At 19.3 s he steps west out of the smoke, still at the window: Lokier sees him, the scripted hit lands about 1 s later, and cart kills Lokier for real.
